title: Malachi
author: Malachi.
date: Fifth century B.C., after the exile.
historicalSetting: Malachi confronts spiritual apathy, corrupt worship, and covenant unfaithfulness while promising the coming messenger.
themes: Hope before the day of the Lord
keyVerse: Malachi 3:1 — "Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me."
christFocus: Malachi points to Christ by promising the Lord's coming and the messenger who prepares His way, fulfilled in John the Baptist and Jesus Christ.
outline: God's love and Israel's dishonor — Malachi 1
The coming Lord and final call — Malachi 3-4
